meta_title: Bilbo's Bits & Bobs | Garden Services Southampton
meta_description: Bilbo's Bits & Bobs offers reliable garden maintenance and landscaping across Southampton. Local, friendly service. Call today for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to regular maintenance, we keep Southampton gardens looking their best without the premium prices.
services_subhead: Whether you need weekly maintenance, a full garden overhaul, or specialist landscaping, we've got you covered.

services.title: Weekly & Fortnightly Maintenance
services.desc: Regular mowing, edging, weeding and pruning to keep your garden tidy year-round. We work around your schedule and bring all our own equipment.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Overhaul
services.desc: Reclaim an overgrown garden. We clear, remove, dispose of waste responsibly, and leave you with a clean slate ready for planting or landscaping.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Tree Work
services.desc: Safe, professional pruning and hedge cutting. We keep trees healthy and shaped, and haul away all cuttings. Small felling available.

services.title: Patio & Decking Cleaning
services.desc: Remove algae, moss and grime from patios, decks and driveways. We use pressure washing where safe and appropriate, restoring your outdoor space.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Design and plant new borders, shrubs and perennials tailored to your soil and light. We source quality plants and establish them properly.

services.title: Garden Tidy-Ups & Spring Prep
services.desc: One-off tidy sessions before summer or after winter. We prune, rake, mulch and prepare beds so your garden looks fresh and ready to grow.

about_pullquote: I started this because I love gardens and hate cowboys. Fair price, honest work.
about_para_1: Bilbo's Bits & Bobs was founded 12 years ago on a simple idea: local gardening should be affordable, reliable and honest. We've grown from a one-man operation to a trusted team serving Southampton and the surrounding areas, completing over 500 garden projects. Every job is done to the same standard we'd use on our own homes.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we show up on time, do what we say we'll do, and treat their gardens with genuine care. We're not a faceless franchise — you deal with us directly, and we remember your preferences and your plants. Many of our clients have worked with us for five years or more.

reviews.text: Bilbo and the team came in and cleared our garden in one afternoon — it was absolutely rammed with rubbish and overgrown beds. They were professional, polite, and didn't charge the earth. We've now got them coming fortnightly for maintenance. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had a quote from three different gardeners. Bilbo was the fairest price and actually bothered to listen to what we wanted. Six months in and the garden is transformed. Best decision we made.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Reliable, friendly, and they always clean up after themselves. They've been looking after our garden for three years now and we wouldn't use anyone else. No faffing about, just solid work.
reviews.author: Janet S.
